headline: Sammaan Capital Limited: Timely Interest Payment Certification on Listed Debentures
sum: Sammaan Capital Limited certified to NSE its timely payment of interest on publicly-issued Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures listed on stock exchanges, pursuant to SEBI Regulation 57 of the LDR Regulations 2015. The disclosure is a routine regulatory compliance certification confirming debt service on listed NCDs.
implication: This filing exemplifies the continuous compliance burden on listed debt issuers under SEBI's Listing Obligations regime-a partner structuring NCD offerings must incorporate post-issuance disclosure infrastructure and calendar controls to meet the timely certification requirement at each coupon date.
detail: Sammaan Capital Limited submitted a regulatory intimation to NSE confirming that the company has made timely payment of interest on its Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures issued via public issue and listed on stock exchanges. The certification is mandated under Regulation 57 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, which requires listed debt issuers to certify timely debt service to the exchange. This is a routine regulatory disclosure, not a corporate action or transaction event, but a standing compliance obligation.
